headline: Hoocrates Dark Knowledge
title: Hoocrates | Attack Boost For Dark Pals | Palworld Guide
video_script: Running Dark Pals? Bring Hoocrates. Its partner skill, Dark Knowledge, raises the Attack of Dark Pals in your party by fifteen to thirty percent, and it does not stack. At base it works Gathering at level one. It is a Dark type from the early Paldeck, so it is easy to add to a team. Which Dark Pal leads your team? Comment below!
description: Hoocrates in Palworld 1.0: Dark Knowledge boosts Dark Pal attack by 15 to 30 percent, plus Gathering level one.
